_about: What a battery earns: the figures the page shows for the months of the public dispatch file (site/public/battery/erw_2026_battery_dispatch.csv: local months 2023-10 to 2026-09, the last twelve 2025-10 to 2026-09), each with its check key (its stat: the page keys a figure bs|<inputs>|<stat>, docs/methods/battery_earns_algorithm.md, section 4; a scenario figure carries no key and is named) and the tolerance to which the replication must meet it (half of the page's last shown digit). Read from the page's library on the file's months and from the page on 14 October 2026 (docs/reviews/packs/battery.md, part 8); check-values.mjs recomputes the page's own keys from battery_stack_monthly on every landing.
